nodes.label: DEV-README (System Architecture & Dev Handoff)
nodes.rationale: Defines the 3-layer model: ClickUp = pipeline UI, autoVSL repo = execution engine, agents = workers, with ClickUp as the message bus (no agent talks directly to another agent). Phase 1 (generation pipeline) done; Phase 2 is sync-clickup.py; custom UI deliberately deferred to Phase 4 only if ClickUp feels limiting.

nodes.label: ClickUp as Pipeline UI (7-step VSL statuses)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over a custom web UI because the team must manually add product shots, spokesperson refs, avatar intel, performance metrics and approvals - a custom UI would take weeks and duplicate ClickUp. One task = one VSL moving through 7 statuses (Research -> Hook/Angle -> Script -> Shot List -> Generating -> Review -> Live/Testing), with custom fields mapping to vsls/<slug>/ JSON.

nodes.label: vsls/<slug>/ Generation Pipeline (VO + video + assemble)
nodes.rationale: Per-VSL folder (brief.md, elevenlabs-vo.json, kling-shots.json, suno-music.txt, timeline.json, media/) as the version-controlled, agent-readable source of truth for generation. Run via scripts/generate-vo.sh (Edge TTS, $0), generate-video.sh (fal.ai Wan 2.2 ~$0.20/clip), assemble-vsl.sh (ffmpeg, $0). Proven end-to-end by the Fairy Flame VSL (~$1.60 for 8 shots).

nodes.label: Fairy Flame VSL (reference implementation)
nodes.rationale: The complete example: 8 VO lines (free), 8 video shots (~$1.60 via fal.ai), assembled locally to output/fairy-flame.mp4 - proof that the Phase 1 pipeline works end-to-end.
